name: DUMBBELL BICEP CURL TO PRESS
introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward. 

Bend your elbows and lift the dumbbells to your shoulders. 

Push the dumbbells over your head while rotating your arms to make your palms face forward. 

Reverse it to lower down. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Exhale as you raise the dumbbells, and inhale as you lower them.
This exercise targets your biceps and shoulders.
